shouldTrigger: Turn this product announcement into a LinkedIn post and an X thread in our voice.
Draft a two-week social content calendar from these research findings.
Write three accurate social hooks for this article and vary the angle.
shouldNotTrigger: Research which topics are starting to trend across YouTube and X.
Generate and render a finished meme image.
Publish this post to my LinkedIn account now.
expectations: The drafts are grounded in supplied or verified source material and flag claims that still need review.
Copy is adapted to each platform and alternatives vary the angle rather than merely changing wording.
The workflow does not copy distinctive public phrasing, fabricate metrics or endorsements, or imitate a living person's voice.
The result remains draft-only and does not claim authenticated account, publishing, scheduling, image-rendering, or private-analytics access.
